prompt: What did the master-data assessment report as complete in September 2024? Give every figure and the document each comes from.

answer.text:
The master-data assessment reported as complete in September 2024 (Kwame Boateng, 30 September 2024) covered the remediation scope for the pilot cohort, with these figures: articles in cohort 4,214; missing case pack quantity 1,317; missing or default supplier lead time 3,105; shelf life populated 48%. The same message states case pack is the blocker, lead times can be worked around by deriving actuals from receipt history, and shelf life is out of scope for this phase. Kwame also attached a file listing the 1,317 articles missing case pack; that attachment is not in the archive, so its contents remain unavailable. [1]

A related figure from the same month comes from the master-data workshop on 24 September 2024, where Kwame reported case pack quantity missing on thirty-one percent of active articles and shelf life populated on forty-eight percent. These are workshop observations rather than the assessment email, but they corroborate the 48% figure. [2] [3]

Note the assessment email itself is the only source for the 4,214 / 1,317 / 3,105 breakdown; the attachment listing the 1,317 articles is not available. [1]

citations.quote:
Priya,
